name: Transkriptor
summary: AI transcription service for meetings, audio and video in 100+ languages, with summaries, translation and a team workspace on higher plans.
description: AI transcription service for meetings, audio and video in 100+ languages, with summaries, translation and a team workspace on higher plans.

pricing.details: Lite 9 €/month — 300 minutes of transcription per month. Pro 18 €/month, or 8 €/month billed 90 € annually — everything in Lite plus 2,400 minutes/month, AI summary, custom meeting-summary templates, AI chat, knowledge base, data not used for training. Team 27 €/month/seat, or 18 €/month/seat billed 217 € annually — everything in Pro plus 3,000 minutes per seat per month, custom vocabulary, call analysis, advanced analytics, centralized team management, custom bot name and avatar. Official bulk hour packs are also listed (e.g. 100 hours 54 €/month, or 27 €/month billed 326 € annually, and larger packs). A “Try it Free” path is offered; no lasting 0 € plan with a documented minute allowance was found on the pricing page
pricing.label: Premium

features: AI transcription of meetings, audio and video in 100+ languages
Edit, translate, share and download transcripts, on web and mobile
Pro adds AI summary, AI chat and a knowledge base; Team adds spaces, custom vocabulary and call analysis
A free trial is offered; there is no permanent free minute allowance on the pricing page.
